trigger: After ADR-0074 wave 2, a server restart or unknown-session verdict makes the gateway send ProxyReattach; the server installs a session and the CONNECTED re-announce writes the route with no agent participation
classification_rationale: l.911-914 claims reattach is subject to the D5 session-start proof; l.963 says reattach is invisible to agents; contradicts ADR-0074 D5 item 1 and the Conflict 1 end condition. I6(a) false assurance

trigger: A compromised gateway rewrites status_tags_pb and recomputes the unkeyed state_digest, sends full=true with any state set, or forges a topology digest / ProxyTopology body
classification_rationale: D16 l.1020-1026 states a tampering bound the D2/D3 design does not provide; ADR-0074 accepted risks cover only liveness
summary: D16's claim that heartbeat tampering is bounded is false: the digest is unkeyed inside the same unsigned bytes, so a gateway can forge tag state that reads as synced and hold or claim IPs via topology
